description: This file contains functions and constants for configuring and validating Matrix account setup within a larger application, including moving account configurations, validating input, and applying account settings.

methods.name: cloneIfObject
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of an object if the input is an object, otherwise returns the value as is.

methods.name: moveSingleMatrixAccountConfigToNamedAccount
methods.description: Rearranges configuration data to promote account-specific settings into named accounts within the configuration object.
